test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Seven girls A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing opposite the center (not necessarily in the same order). E is second to the right of A. C is the immediate neighbour of E. D is third to the right of C. B is the immediate neighbour of E and A. F is fourth to the right of A.

Which of the following statements is correct?

I. D is next to the right of G.

II. A is third to the left of B.
solution:
Seven girls **A, B, C, D, E, F and G** are sitting around a circular table facing opposite the center (not necessarily in the same order).

1. E is second to the right of A.

2. C is the immediate neighbour of E.

3. B is the immediate neighbour of E and A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8babfdf378be520cc9d00687bc2298cd2f86f8fbf5e07c2864ab794ccb8b2174.png] 

 

4. D is third to the right of C.

5. F is fourth to the right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d56bc1b0de46b260263e9094d58a7822f7d37e6fd0ac9126bbadec54219e1a13.png] 

 

G, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

The final arrangement will be as shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c84e2b247fe0a53bc66f79d6d505982e05a2988fd32a9106f29b3c8c8dd9ff1.png] 

 

I. D is next to the right of G. → True

II. A is third to the left of B. → False

Clearly, only I is true.

Hence, '**Only I**' is the correct answer.
